exchanges: hey, long day. rahel and i did a wedding order for 300 people
That is huge. How did it go?
good actually!! the bride was ethiopian so rahel did the whole thing in Amharic with the family, i just smiled and nodded
Sounds like she made the family feel at home.
she was amazing. im starving now tho
What are you going to eat?
agnieszka made pierogi, my absolute favourite, i could eat 30
That sounds like the perfect dinner after a long day.
shes the best wife lol
Sounds like it.
my son elias called from uni, hes in second year engineering and hes stressed about a bridge project
Second year projects can be intense. Is he doing okay?
ya hes fine he just needs to vent
Sometimes that is all people need.
the funny thing is rahels little brother is ALSO elias and hes doing philosophy at the same uni, they bump into each other sometimes
Two people named Elias at one school, that must confuse people.
they call each other elias one and elias two lol
That is a practical solution.
anyway i have pottery tonight, im making a terrible bowl
Every potter starts with terrible bowls.
lol mine is more of a plate at this point
A plate is still useful.
true. moshe the landlord came by about the walk-in fridge
Is it broken?
just making noises. he brought his cat Latke in a carrier for some reason, she sat on the counter like she owned the place
A cat on the counter is a health inspector's nightmare.
i know lol i made him take her out
Good call.
new apprentice pania started this week
How is she settling in?
great, shes from Rotorua in new zealand and says the bread here is too soft lol
Everyone has opinions about bread from home.
she makes a mean sourdough though
Then she can teach you something.
lol maybe
What are you listening to tonight?
Adele, always Adele, shes been my favourite since i was a teenager
Good choice for a long day.
ok im driving home now, well not now, parked
Good, no texting and driving.
lol no. my old Jeep barely starts in the cold
Older cars can struggle in winter.
one more winter maybe
Hopefully it holds out.
oh wait moshe texted, the cat is called Kugel not latke, i misheard him
Easy mix-up.
ok home now
Welcome home.
agnieszka saved me a plate
That is love.
it is lol
Enjoy it.
she has the Juventus match on, shes been a fan since she was a kid, shes yelling at the ref
Sounds like an intense match.
wait whats my son studying again, i always forget the exact thing
ok im gonna eat and go to bed
Good night, enjoy dinner.

earlier_question.right_reply: Your son Elias is in second year engineering.
earlier_question.wrong_reply: Your son Elias is studying philosophy.

questions.message: what do i love eating most
ok im so full, bed time
sorry what does my son elias study
